text:
Aisha (oncall): eu-west-2 GPU nodes showing repeated network fabric timeouts, a bunch of pods getting OOM/restarts and queue growth. Customers in EU are reporting high latency. Investigating now.
Ravi (eng-infra): seeing fabric flaps on the hypervisor layer, NIC errors on 3 racks. Telemetry shows degraded inter-node RPCs.
Jared (SRE): confirmed, pods are healthy but KV cache misses spiking and token latency jumps ~3-5x. Autoscaler isn't bringing new GPUs because scheduling fails on the affected racks.
Aisha (oncall): marking incident and will escalate. @Marta can you prep a short customer-facing blurb? We need status page update: degraded performance for eu-west-2.
Marta (support): on it. Drafting: "We are investigating increased latency and request failures for inference in eu-west-2. Engineers are routing traffic and working on mitigation. No data loss reported." Want approval before posting.
Kai (product): keep wording conservative about failover. If we plan cross-region routing we need to call that out for enterprise customers. Also mention ETA if we have one.
Ravi (eng-infra): mitigation plan: 1) cordon the 3 failing racks to avoid scheduling new pods, 2) shift traffic at the edge for eu-* to fallback pool in us-east-1 with weighted routing, 3) enable temporary prefix caching in the fallback model group to reduce token cost.
Jared (SRE): commands ready, e.g. `kubectl cordon gpu-rack-23-0 gpu-rack-23-1 gpu-rack-24-0` and `traffic-router set route --from eu-west-2 --to us-east-1 --weight 0.8 --grace 30s`.
Aisha (oncall): what's the risk of cross-region egress charges + SLO regressions? Need ok from finance/product for cost-sensitive customers.
Kai (product): for PLG customers we can do auto-failover. For enterprise with data residency, we need explicit opt-in. Drafting targeted enterprise DM to support.
Marta (support): I'll call top 10 active enterprise customers in EU and send the DM template. What ETA can we give?
Ravi (eng-infra): estimated time to shift traffic and validate fallbacks: ~35-50 minutes. Draining and warming caches adds ~20m. Root cause remediation (hardware replacement / NIC firmware) is likely several hours.
Jared (SRE): I'll run the traffic shift during a quiet minute and monitor token latency, KV hit rate, and 5xxs. If we see >2% 5xx, rollback.
Aisha (oncall): go ahead with traffic shift. @SRE-bot, create incident ticket IN-2026-042 and link to this thread.
SRE-bot: Incident IN-2026-042 created. Assigned: oncall, eng-infra, eng-sre. Severity: P2.
Statuspage-bot: Suggested status update: "Degraded performance — eu-west-2 GPU inference (investigating)." Add ETA: 45 minutes for mitigation step.
Marta (support): Posted to status page with ETA 45 minutes and enterprise DM queued. Copy below for review: "We are experiencing degraded performance in eu-west-2 impacting inference latency. Engineers are shifting traffic to an alternate region and expect mitigation within ~45 minutes. No customer data impact has been detected. Enterprise customers with residency requirements have been contacted separately."
Kai (product): good. Add note about potential temporary increased costs due to cross-region egress for some workloads.
Ravi (eng-infra): starting traffic shift now: `traffic-router set route --from eu-west-2 --to us-east-1 --weight 0.6 --grace 20s` then increase to 0.8 after 5 min if metrics look good.
Jared (SRE): observing metrics: token p95 dropping from 4.2s -> 1.1s for shifted traffic, 5xx steady at 0.2%. KV hit rate improving. No immediate rollbacks.
Aisha (oncall): ping support — let partners know we shifted; tell customers to report any anomalies.
Marta (support): Sent DMs to enterprise contacts, opened escalation channels for 3 customers requesting SLA credits.
Kai (product): Product note: enable opt-in cross-region for sensitive customers after incident. Add checklist for future: pre-warmed fallback pools, explicit billing notice.
Ravi (eng-infra): follow-up tasks: replace NICs on faulty hosts (ticketed to HW ops), adjust placement constraints to avoid those racks, and run a firmware rollout next maintenance window.
Jared (SRE): postmortem owners? I'll take on mitigation timeline, Ravi on root cause and hardware, Aisha on customer comms.
Aisha (oncall): thanks team. Keeping thread open until full restoration. Current status: mitigated (traffic shifted), monitoring. ETA for full recovery: TBD — hardware replacement in progress (~3-6 hours).
Marta (support): I'll update status page to "mitigated — monitoring" and add note that some customers may see cross-region charges; support will assist with billing inquiries.
SRE-bot: Incident IN-2026-042 status changed to "mitigated".
Jared (SRE): final check: no ongoing queue growth, autoscaler now scheduling into fallback pool as expected.
Aisha (oncall): closing notes will be in the postmortem. Leaving this thread to collect any late customer feedback. :white_check_mark:
